scientific.integrity: The published cubic was differentiated exactly; the singular-locus case split, Hessian ranks, normal-slice equation and kernel cubic coefficient were recomputed symbolically. The proof uses the source statement that the displayed ideal is prime.
scientific.limitations: Specific to the colored 3-chain case 2 over the complex numbers; lower-dimensional collision strata inside the diagonal singular plane are not classified.

title: Normal colored 3-chain Gibbs cubic with transverse A2 and A1 strata
